			ISR = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ZIM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ZIM }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = ISR ISR = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR } } ISR = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_signed SOV = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_signed } COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SOV_clear = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_ZIM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_ZIM }
			SOV = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_SOV } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_ZIM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_ZIM }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_SOV } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_signed CHI = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_signed } COLDWAR_RHO_pair_CHI_clear = yes }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM }
			CHI = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI } } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_ZIM }
			if = { limit = { country_exists = CHI CHI = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI } } CHI = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_RHO_FLV_partner_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SAF }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SAF_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SAF }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SAF_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POR }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_POR_clear = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_signed } } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ENG }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_ENG_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = USA }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_USA_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ZAM }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_ZAM_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FRA }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_FRA_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ISR }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_ISR_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SOV }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_SOV_clear = yes } }

	}

		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ZIM has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_signed ZIM = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_signed COLDWAR_RHO_pair_CHI_clear = yes } }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI }
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI }
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_RHO_FLV_cleanup_orphaned_partner_deals = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { original_tag = ZIM } NOT = { country_exists = ZIM } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_FLV_deal_partner }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_SAF }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_coin_SAF }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_por_alcora_POR }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_eng_settlement_ENG }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_usa_byrd_USA }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_zam_rail_ZAM }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_fra_alouette_FRA }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_isr_uzi_ISR }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_SOV } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_sov_zipra_SOV }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_chi_zanla_CHI }
	}
}

COLDWAR_RHO_FLV_cancel_saf_beitbridge = {
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ZIM }
		hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_signed }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_ZIM } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_RHO_deal_saf_beitbridge_ZIM }
		hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { country_exists = SAF } SAF = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_RHO_BILAT.952 } } } }
	}
}
